iroc-church-fredericksburg.assessment: IROC Church (formerly Fredericksburg Assembly of God) is a Pentecostal/AG church led by Pastor Steve Messick (son of founding pastor David Messick). The Assemblies of God affirm the Trinity and inerrancy but add charismatic theology including tongues as initial evidence of Spirit baptism. Male-led, which is positive. Yellow due to Pentecostal distinctives that may concern cessationists.
